senses.definition_en: stewardess, flight attendant

examples.english: Today I have to do stewardess work.
examples.text: Tengo que trabajar hoy de azafata.
examples.translation: Today I have to do stewardess work.

examples.english: According to the uniform protocol of airlines like Iberia, during the flight, flight attendants have to wear low-heeled shoes (3 to 5 cm), and for boarding, unboarding, and walking through the terminal, a high heel (5 to 10 cm).
examples.ref: 2017 May 26, Elisa Sánchez Fernández, “'Pies de azafata': así sufren el sexismo de tener que llevar tacones en su trabajo”, in El País:
examples.text: Según el protocolo de uniformidad de aerolíneas como Iberia, durante el vuelo las azafatas tienen que calzar tacón bajo (de 3 a 5 cm) y para embarcar, desembarcar y caminar por la terminal, el alto (de 5 a 10 cm).
examples.translation: According to the uniform protocol of airlines like Iberia, during the flight, flight attendants have to wear low-heeled shoes (3 to 5 cm), and for boarding, unboarding, and walking through the terminal, a high heel (5 to 10 cm).

glosses: stewardess, flight attendant
